title: Storage & Volumes
summary: Where container data actually lives: the writable layer, named volumes, bind mounts and tmpfs, plus permissions, macOS performance, Postgres persistence and volume backup/restore.
objectives: Explain why data written to a container's writable layer disappears and what copy-on-write costs
Choose correctly between named volumes, bind mounts and tmpfs mounts for a given job
Use both `--mount` and `-v` syntax and explain their behavioural differences
Diagnose and fix UID/GID permission problems on mounted directories
Persist PostgreSQL data safely and back up / restore a named volume
Understand bind-mount performance on macOS (VirtioFS, synchronized file shares) and work around it
